purchases.no_open_bills: No outstanding bills in this currency. The payment will remain available as an advance.
purchases.allocation_help: Update how this balance is applied. Setting an amount to zero releases it and reopens the bill balance.
purchases.refund_help: Record money actually returned by a supplier. Refunds use an available credit or an unapplied payment balance.
purchases.void_help: Voiding corrects an entry recorded in error. Record a refund when money was actually returned.
purchases.attachment_error: The record was saved, but an attachment could not be uploaded. Add it again below.
purchases.cash_help: Direct expenses plus supplier payments, less money returned. Includes advances; applying an existing balance does not move cash.
purchases.cost_help: Expenses and posted bills, less supplier credits, by document date. Advances and refunds do not create additional costs.
purchases.payables_help: Current balances, independent of the selected reporting period. Advances and credits remain separate until applied.
purchases.tax_basis_help: Purchase tax snapshots by document date, including reductions from supplier credits.
purchases.bill_help: Record a supplier invoice and track what you owe. Record payments separately as you settle it.
purchases.expense_help: Record a purchase you have already paid for. To track an unpaid supplier invoice, use Bills.
purchases.empty_suppliers: Add the people and businesses you buy from to track their bills and payments.
purchases.empty_bills: Add a supplier bill to track what you owe and when it is due.
purchases.empty_supplier-payments: Record money paid to a supplier and apply it to their bills.
purchases.empty_supplier-credits: Record a supplier credit for returned goods or a price adjustment.
purchases.empty_supplier-refunds: Record money a supplier returned against a credit or advance.
purchases.choose_supplier_first: Choose a supplier to see their outstanding bills.
purchases.empty_recurring_bills: Set up a schedule to create regular supplier bills, such as rent or utilities.
purchases.empty_recurring_expenses: Schedule known recurring charges, such as subscriptions, to be recorded as paid expenses.
purchases.recurring_bills_help: Recurring bills create an unpaid bill from a template on a schedule, each due a set number of days after it is made.
purchases.recurring_expenses_help: Recurring expenses record a paid expense from a template on a schedule, for known charges such as subscriptions paid by card.
purchases.schedule_help: Schedules run in your company time zone. The first run can fall on the start date, and runs missed while the scheduler was down are made later.
purchases.saved_rate_help: Each run uses the saved exchange rate. Update the schedule when the rate changes.
purchases.paid_expense_help: Each run records the expense as already paid. Nothing is paid or checked against a bank account.
purchases.create_as_draft_help: Each bill waits as a draft for you to review and record, useful when the amount changes from one period to the next, such as utilities.
purchases.notify_creator_help: Send me an email when a record is generated or a run fails.
purchases.recurring_locked: This schedule has generated records, so its supplier and type stay as they are.
purchases.confirm_delete_schedule: The schedule stops and is deleted. The bills and expenses it generated are kept.

pdf_cash_basis_note: Cash view: payments and refunds are counted on their transaction dates. Supplier advances are included. See Purchases for costs by document date.

page_help.dashboard: Review the selected company’s key totals and recent activity. Change the period to explore another date range, or open Reports for a detailed breakdown.
page_help.customers: Manage the people and businesses you invoice. Open a customer to review their documents, payments, and outstanding balance.
page_help.items: Save reusable products and services with their descriptions, prices, and taxes, then add them to estimates and invoices.
page_help.estimates: Připravte zákazníkovi nabídku. Jakmile ji přijme, můžete z ní vystavit fakturu.
page_help.invoices: Vystavujte faktury a sledujte jejich splatnost a stav úhrady. Přijaté platby zaznamenejte po připsání peněz.
page_help.recurring_invoices: Schedule invoices to be generated at a chosen frequency. Review the schedule and delivery settings to control when invoices are created and sent.
page_help.payments: Evidujte přijaté platby, jejich datum a způsob úhrady. Přiřazením platby k faktuře se aktualizuje zbývající částka.
page_help.expenses: Record a purchase you have already paid for. Use Bills to track an unpaid supplier invoice and settle it later; paying a bill does not create another expense.
page_help.reports: Vyberte přehled, nastavte období a další filtry a zobrazte nebo stáhněte PDF.
page_help.sales_report: Review invoiced sales for the selected period, grouped by customer or item. Change the grouping and dates before viewing or downloading the report.
page_help.profit_loss_report: Compare income and cash spending for the selected period. This report uses the cash basis: supplier payments, including advances, and supplier refunds affect cash when recorded.
page_help.expenses_report: Review recorded expenses for the selected period. For a combined view of expenses, bills, supplier payments, and refunds, open the Purchases report.
page_help.tax_report: Review tax on issued invoices, expenses, recorded bills, and credits by document date. Unpaid documents are included; payments and refunds do not add tax.
page_help.purchases_report: Review purchase costs and cash movement for the selected period and supplier. Payables show current balances as of the displayed date.
page_help.credit_notes: Dobropisem snížíte fakturovanou částku. Pokud zákazníkovi vracíte peníze, zaznamenejte vratku samostatně.

pdf_purchases_cash_note: Expenses and supplier payments, less refunds, by transaction date. Advances are included.
pdf_purchase_tax_basis_note: Expenses and recorded bills, less supplier credits, by document date. Payments and refunds do not add purchase tax.
pdf_payables_as_of_note: Balances as of :date, independent of the selected reporting period. Unapplied advances and credits are shown separately.
pdf_tax_document_basis_note: Document-date basis: issued invoices, recorded bills and credits are included whether paid or unpaid. Expenses use their expense date. Payments and refunds do not create additional tax.

inbox.empty_unread_description: There is nothing you have not read yet.

company_defaults.title: Defaults for members
